q_vouchers.summary: Says on his campaign issues page that voucher schemes siphon money from public schools and that "We say NO to vouchers."

q_school_funding.summary: Says on his campaign issues page that the state should invest in public schools, pay teachers what they deserve and lower class sizes.

q_textualism.summary: Says on his campaign site that his experience reinforced his commitment to impartiality, "ensuring judges interpret the law rather than legislate from the bench."

q_textualism.summary: Describes herself on her campaign site as a constitutional conservative who believes in judicial restraint and says judges must interpret the law as it is written and not create it.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia candidate survey posted on his campaign site, says he believes in judicial restraint and that judges should not legislate from the bench but should apply and enforce the rule of law.

q_min_wage.summary: Her campaign issues page calls for raising and indexing the federal minimum wage so it better reflects the cost of living.

q_medicaid.summary: Her campaign issues page calls for strengthening Medicare and Medicaid, permanently extending enhanced Affordable Care Act subsidies and pursuing a public option; it does not specifically call for Medicaid expansion (corrected from a Branch summary).

q_border_state.summary: His campaign site says he helped secure over $6 billion to defend the southern border and passed legislation aimed at drug cartels and human smugglers.

q_legal_status.summary: His campaign issues page calls for a clear and fair pathway to citizenship for those pursuing legal immigration and permanent protections for Dreamers; it does not describe a broader legalization plan (corrected from a Branch summary).

q_abortion.summary: Her campaign positions page calls for improving access to reproductive health care and reinstating abortion rights after Roe v. Wade was overturned.

q_medicaid.summary: Her campaign positions page calls for universal health care not tied to employment and for protecting the Affordable Care Act; it does not address Texas Medicaid expansion specifically.
Her campaign issues page says tying health insurance to jobs is "absurd" and argues for a single-payer health insurance system, which goes beyond Medicaid expansion.
Her campaign health care page says she believes health care is a right and is a strong supporter of Medicaid expansion and the Affordable Care Act.

q_abortion.summary: His campaign accomplishments page says he supports "assuring every woman retains the right to make her own healthcare decisions."

q_legal_status.summary: Proposed the Save the American Workforce Act to let businesses sponsor undocumented immigrants with at least five years in the U.S. and no criminal record for renewable three-year visas; he describes it as "a temporary path," and it would not offer citizenship.

q_gun_laws.summary: His campaign issues page pledges to "protect the God-given right to keep and bear arms from any infringement, federal or otherwise" (position strengthened from a Branch summary).

q_abortion.summary: His campaign issues page lists "Defending Life, Faith & Freedom" and pledges to "protect the unborn."

q_fossil_priority.summary: His campaign issues page calls for unleashing Texas oil, gas and nuclear energy to restore U.S. energy dominance and lower costs.

q_voting_access.summary: His campaign issues page lists election integrity and ballot security and says elections should "make sure only U.S. citizens vote" and "make it impossible to cheat."

q_federal_spending.summary: His campaign issues page calls for expanding DOGE "to cut insane wasteful spending."

q_gun_laws.summary: His campaign issues page lists defending the Second Amendment and says he is a proud gun owner and lifetime NRA member; it does not state opposition to all federal gun regulations (corrected from a Branch summary).

q_abortion.summary: His campaign issues page says, "I 100% support the right to life as the first and most vital right."

q_fossil_priority.summary: His campaign issues page says he will always stand for the oil and gas sector, supports President Trump's order to "unleash American energy," and calls control of our own energy essential to national security.

q_medicaid.summary: His campaign platform page says he will "work toward Medicare for All," which goes beyond Medicaid expansion.

q_fossil_priority.summary: Her campaign issues page says she helped pass the largest clean energy investment in the nation's history and is focused on expanding clean energy to address climate change.

q_abortion.summary: His campaign platform page pledges to propose and co-sponsor legislation like the Women's Health Protection Act and to advocate a constitutional amendment enshrining women's bodily autonomy.

q_voting_access.summary: His campaign democracy page says he will fight to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act and push for automatic and same-day registration.

q_medicaid.summary: His campaign health care page calls for Medicare for All and says he will fight to expand Medicare and strengthen Medicaid.

q_oilgas_rules.summary: His campaign clean air and water page says he will fight for tougher environmental protections, hold polluters accountable and fund cleanup of contaminated sites; it does not address oil and gas rules specifically.

q_min_wage.summary: Her campaign issues page says "I will fight for an increase in the minimum wage" and a living wage across the state; it does not name a $15 figure (corrected from a Branch summary).

q_abortion.summary: Her campaign issues page says women's health care must be protected and calls for policies on reproductive care that "respect women's autonomy and ensure access to comprehensive services."

q_tariffs.summary: His campaign home page lists "Remove the Tariffs" among his positions.

q_vouchers.summary: Her campaign site pledges to "empower parents with school choice" and defend parental rights.

q_federal_spending.summary: Her campaign site calls for "cutting reckless federal spending and fighting inflation" to lower costs.

q_fossil_priority.summary: Her campaign site pledges to keep energy decisions in Texas, support oil and natural gas, and strengthen grid reliability.

q_abortion.summary: Her campaign issues page says overturning Roe v. Wade was "a historic failure" and that she is fighting to pass the Women's Health Protection Act to safeguard access to abortion and IVF.

q_legal_status.summary: Her campaign issues page says she is lead sponsor of the Dream and Promise Act, which would create a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers, and supports expanding Temporary Protected Status.

q_deportation.summary: Her campaign issues page calls her an advocate for immigrants who has fought to close abusive detention centers and supports "fair, compassionate immigration policies."

q_gun_laws.summary: His campaign site lists "Protect the Second Amendment" and says "God-given rights don't need D.C.'s permission."

q_medicaid.summary: His campaign platform page calls for "Free, Universal Healthcare for All," which goes beyond Medicaid expansion.

q_spending_cap.summary: His campaign about page says he authored legislation to "put in place common sense caps on government spending" and lists placing fiscal restraints on government growth and spending.

q_border_state.summary: His campaign issues page calls for fully funding State Troopers and the Texas National Guard and demands federal reimbursement for Texas border security spending.

q_abortion.summary: His campaign issues page says "we must always protect innocent life, born and unborn" and that tax dollars should never fund any entity involved with abortion.

q_medicaid.summary: Her campaign issues page says she is running to pass universal health care paid for by wealth taxes, and her bio describes a universal system not attached to an employer.

q_abortion.summary: Her campaign issues page pledges to protect innocent life and remove barriers so the private sector can provide resources to women facing crisis pregnancies.

q_gun_laws.summary: Her campaign issues page pledges to "protect Texan's right to keep and bear arms."

q_bail.summary: Her campaign issues page pledges to "keep violent, repeat criminals behind bars."

q_gun_laws.summary: His campaign issues page pledges to "oppose any form of gun control" and "stop red flag laws" (position strengthened from a Branch summary).

q_vouchers.summary: His campaign site says he "does not support diverting funds from our public schools into the Greg Abbott-backed Voucher Program."

q_school_funding.summary: His campaign site says "We need increased funding for our public schools and higher salaries for our teachers and staff."

q_abortion.summary: His campaign site says that although he is pro-life, he "will work to restore the reproductive freedoms of women in Texas" and that each woman has the right to decide in consultation with family, church leaders and doctors (position adjusted from a Branch summary to reflect his stated personal pro-life view).

q_vouchers.summary: His campaign site says, "I'll fight to stop school vouchers, which drain money from the public schools most of our families depend on."

q_vouchers.summary: His campaign site pledges to "oppose efforts to drain funds into unaccountable voucher programs."
